verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since an inference platform's console could offer AI-generated insights on a user's own usage or data, but the evidence shows no such feature. The console is described only as a dashboard for projects, API keys, usage, billing and team access. The Playground and the raw model APIs are general-purpose building blocks a developer could use to construct insights, not an in-product insights feature, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
